sentences.zh: 庚寅，大閱諸軍於含元殿庭，上御棲鸞閣觀之。

translations.literal: On gengyin a great review of the armies was held in the courtyard of Hanyuan Hall; the emperor watched from Qiluan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the armies were mustered in review at Hanyuan Hall; the emperor watched from Qiluan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 庚子，冊良娣張氏為淑妃。

translations.literal: On gengzi Lady Zhang, worthy consort, was invested as imperial consort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Lady Zhang, worthy consort, was elevated to imperial consort.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯朔，賊將偽淄青節度能元皓以其地請降，用為河北招討使，並其子昱並授官爵。

translations.literal: On the guimao new moon of the second month the rebel general and false Ziqing commissioner Neng Yuanhao offered his territory in surrender; he was made Hebei pacification commissioner, and his son Yu was also granted rank and title.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon Neng Yuanhao, the rebels' Ziqing commissioner, surrendered his territory; he was made Hebei pacification commissioner and his son Yu received rank as well.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上御興慶宮，奉冊上皇徽號曰太上至道聖皇大帝。

translations.literal: On yisi the emperor visited Xingqing Palace and presented the Retired Emperor with the honorific Supreme Sovereign of the Utmost Way and Sacred Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi at Xingqing Palace the emperor invested the Retired Emperor as Supreme Sovereign of the Utmost Way and Sacred Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，御明鳳門，大赦天下，改至德三載為乾元元年。

translations.literal: On dingwei he took Mingfeng Gate, granted a great amnesty to the realm, and changed the third year of Zhide to the first year of Qianyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he appeared at Mingfeng Gate, proclaimed a great amnesty, and renamed Zhide 3 to Qianyuan 1.

sentences.zh: 成都、靈武扈從功臣三品已上與一子官，五品已下與一子出身，六品已下量與改轉。

translations.literal: Meritorious followers from Chengdu and Lingwu of third rank and above received office for one son; of fifth rank and below, entry qualification for one son; of sixth rank and below, promotion as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Followers from Chengdu and Lingwu of third rank and above gained office for a son; fifth rank and below, examination entry for a son; sixth rank and below, promotion where merited.

sentences.zh: 死王事、陷賊不受偽命而死者，並與追贈。

translations.literal: Those who died in the king's service, or who died in rebel-held territory refusing false appointment, were all posthumously ennobled.
translations.idiomatic: Men who died in the state's service, or who perished in rebel lands refusing false office, were posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 陷賊官先推鞫者，例減罪一等。

translations.literal: Among officials who had served the rebels, those already interrogated had their crimes reduced one degree by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Collaborators already under investigation had their sentences reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: 今後醫卜入仕者，同明法例處分。

translations.literal: Henceforth those entering office through medicine or divination were to be treated by the same rules as those in the legal examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth medical and divination candidates entered office under the same rules as legal specialists.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉朔。

translations.literal: Third month, guiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon of the third month.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，元帥楚王俶改封成王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the commander-in-chief Prince of Chu Li Chu was renamed Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Chu, Prince of Chu and commander-in-chief, became Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，山南東道、河南、淮南、江南皆置節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai military commissioners were established in Shannan East Circuit, Henan, Huainan, and Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai military commissioners were placed over Shannan East, Henan, Huainan, and Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以歲饑，禁酤酒，麥熟之後，任依常式。

translations.literal: On xinmao, because of famine, the sale of wine was forbidden until after the wheat harvest, when the usual rules might apply.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao famine led to a ban on wine sales until the wheat harvest, when normal rules resumed.

sentences.zh: 太史監為司天臺，取承寧坊張守珪宅置，仍補官員六十人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy became the Bureau of Celestial Offices, housed in Zhang Shougui's former residence in Chengnning Ward, with sixty posts filled.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy became the Bureau of Celestial Offices, installed in Zhang Shougui's Chengnning Ward mansion, with sixty new posts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，以太子少師、嗣虢王巨為東京留守、河南尹，充京畿採訪處置使。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the fourth summer month, junior preceptor of the heir apparent and heir to Prince of Guo Li Ju was made Eastern Capital regent, Henan intendant, and commissioner for capital-region procurement and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the fourth summer month Li Ju, junior preceptor of the heir apparent and heir to Prince of Guo, became Eastern Capital regent, Henan intendant, and commissioner for the capital region.

sentences.zh: 己酉，冊淑妃張氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On jiyou Imperial Consort Zhang was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Imperial Consort Zhang was crowned empress.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，九廟成，備法駕自長安殿迎九廟神主入新廟。

translations.literal: On xinhai the Nine Ancestral Temple was completed; the spirit tablets were escorted by full imperial equipage from Chang'an Hall into the new temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, with the Nine Ancestral Temple finished, spirit tablets were borne in full procession from Chang'an Hall to the new shrine.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上親享九廟，遂有事於圓丘，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin the emperor personally sacrificed at the Nine Ancestral Temple, then performed the suburban rites at the Round Altar, returning to the palace that day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the emperor sacrificed at the Nine Ancestral Temple, then at the Round Altar, and returned to the palace the same day.

sentences.zh: 翌日，御明鳳門，大赦天下。

translations.literal: The next day he took Mingfeng Gate and granted a great amnesty to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he appeared at Mingfeng Gate and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上進煉石英金灶於興慶宮。

translations.literal: On wuchen the emperor presented a refined-quartz gold furnace to Xingqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the emperor sent a gold furnace of refined quartz to Xingqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申朔，回紇、黑衣大食各遣使朝貢，至閣門爭長，詔其使各從左右門入。

translations.literal: On the renshen new moon of the fifth month the Uyghurs and the Black-robed Arabs each sent envoys with tribute; at the Gate of Barbarian Submission they quarreled over precedence, and an edict ordered each embassy to enter by the left or right gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon Uyghur and Black-robed Arab envoys arrived with tribute and quarreled over precedence at the Gate of Barbarian Submission; each embassy was told to enter by a separate gate.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔：「近緣狂寇亂常，諸道分置節度，蓋總管內徵發、文牒往來，仍加採訪，轉滋煩擾。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict said: "Recently, because the mad rebels disturbed order, military commissioners were placed in every circuit to oversee internal levies and the traffic of documents; with the addition of procurement commissioners, burdens only grew.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict read: "Since the rebels shattered order, every circuit gained a military commissioner to command levies and paperwork—and with procurement commissioners added, the burden only worsened.

sentences.zh: 其諸道先置採訪、黜陟二使宜停。

translations.literal: The procurement and promotion-and-demotion commissioners previously set in each circuit should be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: The procurement and promotion commissioners in every circuit are abolished."

sentences.zh: 」癸未夜，月掩心前星。

translations.literal: On the night of guiwei the moon occulted the star before the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiwei the moon passed before the star preceding the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以河南節度、中書侍郎、平章事張鎬為荊州大都督府長史、本州防禦使，以禮部尚書崔光遠為河南節度。

translations.literal: On wuzi Henan military commissioner and vice director of the Secretariat Zhang Hao was made grand protector of Jingzhou and defender of that prefecture; Minister of Rites Cui Guangyuan was made Henan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhang Hao, Henan commissioner and vice director, became grand protector of Jingzhou and its defender; Cui Guangyuan, minister of rites, took Henan command.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立成王俶為皇太子。

translations.literal: On gengyin Prince of Cheng Li Chu was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Chu, Prince of Cheng, was named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 以荊州長史季廣琛赴河南行營會計討賊於河北。

translations.literal: Jingzhou chief administrator Ji Guangchen was sent to the Henan field headquarters to settle accounts and pursue the rebels in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Guangchen, chief administrator of Jingzhou, was dispatched to the Henan headquarters to settle accounts and join the Hebei campaign.

sentences.zh: 已未，中書令崔圓為太子少師，刑部尚書、同平章事李麟為太子少傅，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: On jiwei Director of the Secretariat Cui Yuan was made junior preceptor of the heir apparent; Minister of Justice and associate director Li Lin junior grand tutor of the heir apparent—both were removed from active governance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Cui Yuan, director of the Secretariat, became junior preceptor of the heir apparent; Li Lin, minister of justice and associate director, junior grand tutor—both left the council.

sentences.zh: 以太常少卿、知禮儀事王璵為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wang Yu, knowing ritual affairs, was made vice director of the Secretariat and associate director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yu, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and master of ritual, joined the council as vice director of the Secretariat and associate director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙申，敦煌王承寀薨。

translations.literal: On bingshen Prince of Dunhuang Li Chengcai died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Chengcai, Prince of Dunhuang, died.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑朔，吐火羅、康國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the xinchou new moon of the sixth month Tokharistan and Kang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon envoys arrived from Tokharistan and Kang with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，初置太一神壇於圓丘東。

translations.literal: On jiyou the Grand Unity Spirit Altar was first established east of the Round Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Grand Unity Spirit Altar was erected east of the Round Altar.

sentences.zh: 是日，命宰相王璵攝行祠事。

translations.literal: That day the chancellor Wang Yu was ordered to perform the sacrifice by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: That day Chancellor Wang Yu was ordered to officiate at the rites.

sentences.zh: 癸丑夜，月入南斗魁。

translations.literal: On the night of guichou the moon entered the Dipper's leading stars.
translations.idiomatic: That night of guichou the moon passed into the Dipper's leading stars.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔：「三司所推劾受賊偽官等，恩澤頻加，科條遞減，原其事狀，稍近平人，所推問者，並宜釋放。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict said: "Those impeached by the Three Offices for accepting false rebel appointments have repeatedly received grace; the charges have been reduced step by step, and considering the facts their cases now approach those of common men—the interrogated should all be released."
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict declared: "Collaborators impeached by the Three Offices have already seen repeated leniency; their offenses have been reduced until their cases resemble those of ordinary men—all under investigation shall be released."

translations.literal: 」 — closing quotation of the edict.
translations.idiomatic: [Close of edict.]

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未朔，吐火羅葉護烏利多並九國首領來朝，助國討賊，上令赴朔方行營。

translations.literal: On the xinwei new moon of the seventh autumn month the Tokharistan protector Ulida and chiefs of nine states came to court to aid the realm against the rebels; the emperor ordered them to the Shuofang field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon Ulida, Tokharistan protector, and chiefs of nine states came to aid the campaign; the emperor sent them to the Shuofang headquarters.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，初鑄新錢，文曰「乾元重寶」，用一當十，與開元通寶同行用。

translations.literal: On bingxu new coin was first cast, inscribed Qianyuan Heavy Treasure, valued at ten and circulated alongside Kaiyuan Tongbao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu new coin was cast—Qianyuan Heavy Treasure, ten to one Kaiyuan Tongbao—and put into circulation.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，制上第二女寧國公主出降回紇英武威遠毗伽可汗。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict made the emperor's second daughter Princess Ningguo marry the Uyghur qaghan Yingwu Weiyuan Piqie.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Princess Ningguo, the emperor's second daughter, was given in marriage to the Uyghur qaghan Yingwu Weiyuan Piqie.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，以青徐等五州節度使季廣琛兼許州刺史，河南節度使崔光遠兼汴州刺史。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eighth month Ji Guangchen, military commissioner of Qing, Xu, and five other prefectures, was made concurrent prefect of Xu; Cui Guangyuan, Henan military commissioner, was made concurrent prefect of Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Ji Guangchen, commissioner of Qing, Xu, and five prefectures, also took Xu; Cui Guangyuan, Henan commissioner, also took Bian.

sentences.zh: 以青州刺史許叔冀兼滑州刺史，充青滑六州節度使。

translations.literal: Qing prefect Xu Shuji was made concurrent prefect of Hua and military commissioner of the six prefectures of Qing and Hua.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shuji, prefect of Qing, was made commissioner of Qing and Hua and concurrent prefect of Hua.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上皇誕節，上皇宴百官於金明門樓。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Retired Emperor's birthday, the Retired Emperor feasted the hundred officials at the Jinming Gate tower.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Retired Emperor's birthday, he feasted the hundred officials atop the Jinming Gate tower.

sentences.zh: 朔方節度使郭子儀、河東節度使李光弼、關內節度使王思禮來朝，加子儀中書令，光弼侍中，思禮兵部尚書，餘如故。

translations.literal: Shuofang military commissioner Guo Ziyi, Hedong military commissioner Li Guangbi, and Guannei military commissioner Wang Sili came to court; Guo Ziyi was made director of the Secretariat, Li Guangbi chief minister, Wang Sili minister of war—the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi of Shuofang, Li Guangbi of Hedong, and Wang Sili of Guannei came to court; Ziyi became director of the Secretariat, Guangbi chief minister, Sili minister of war—other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，右羽林大將軍趙泚為蒲州刺史、蒲同虢三州節度使，貝州刺史能元皓為齊州刺史、齊兗鄆等州防禦使。

translations.literal: On the gengwu new moon of the ninth month Right Feathered Forest Grand General Zhao Kui was made prefect of Pu and military commissioner of Pu, Tong, and Guo; Bei prefect Neng Yuanhao was made prefect of Qi and defender of Qi, Yan, and Yun.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon Zhao Kui, right feathered forest grand general, took Pu and command of Pu, Tong, and Guo; Neng Yuanhao, prefect of Bei, took Qi and defense of Qi, Yan, and Yun.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大舉討安慶緒於相州。

translations.literal: On gengyin a great campaign was launched against An Qingxu at Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court opened a major campaign against An Qingxu at Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 命朔方節度郭子儀、河東節度李光弼、關內潞州節度使王思禮、淮西襄陽節度魯炅、興平節度李奐、滑濮節度許叔冀、平盧兵馬使董秦、北庭行營節度使李嗣業、鄭蔡節度使季廣琛等九節度之師，步騎二十萬，以開府魚朝恩為觀軍容使。

translations.literal: Nine military commissioners were ordered—Guo Ziyi of Shuofang, Li Guangbi of Hedong, Wang Sili of Guannei and Luzhou, Lu Qiong of Huaixi and Xiangyang, Li Huan of Xingping, Xu Shuji of Hua and Pu, Dong Qin of Pinglu, Li Siye of the Northern Court field headquarters, and Ji Guangchen of Zheng and Cai—with two hundred thousand foot and horse, and Kai fu Yu Chao'en as army-inspecting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Nine commissioners—Guo Ziyi, Li Guangbi, Wang Sili, Lu Qiong, Li Huan, Xu Shuji, Dong Qin, Li Siye, and Ji Guangchen—led two hundred thousand men, with Yu Chao'en as army-inspecting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，廣州奏大食國、波斯國兵眾攻城，刺史韋利見棄城而遁。

translations.literal: On guisi Guangzhou reported that the armies of the Arabs and Persia were besieging the city; prefect Wei Lijian abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Guangzhou reported Arab and Persian forces besieging the city; Prefect Wei Lijian fled.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，以鳳翔尹李齊物為刑部尚書，以濮州刺史張方須為廣州都督、五府節度使。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the tenth month Fengxiang intendant Li Qiwu was made minister of justice; Pu prefect Zhang Fangxu was made grand protector of Guangzhou and commissioner of the five protectorates.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Qiwu, Fengxiang intendant, became minister of justice; Zhang Fangxu, Pu prefect, grand protector of Guangzhou and commissioner of the five protectorates.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀奏破賊十萬於衛州，獲安慶緒弟慶和，進收衛州。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi memorialized that one hundred thousand rebels had been broken at Weizhou; An Qingxu's brother Qinghe was captured, and Weizhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi reported crushing one hundred thousand rebels at Weizhou, capturing Qingxu's brother Qinghe and recovering the city.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上皇幸華清宮，上送於灞上。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Retired Emperor visited Huaqing Palace; the emperor escorted him to Ba River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Retired Emperor went to Huaqing Palace; the emperor saw him off at Ba River.

sentences.zh: 許叔冀奏：「衛州婦人侯四娘、滑州婦人唐四娘、某州婦人王二娘相與歃血，請赴行營討賊。

translations.literal: Xu Shuji memorialized: "The women Hou Siniang of Weizhou, Tang Siniang of Huazhou, and Wang Erniang of a certain prefecture together swore blood-oath and asked to join the field headquarters to attack the rebels."
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shuji reported: "Hou Siniang of Weizhou, Tang Siniang of Huazhou, and Wang Erniang of another prefecture swore a blood oath and begged to join the campaign against the rebels."

sentences.zh: 」皆補果毅。

translations.literal: 」All were appointed as guoyi officers.
translations.idiomatic: [Close of memorial.] All three were commissioned as guoyi officers.

sentences.zh: 壬申，王思禮破賊二萬於相州。

translations.literal: On renshen Wang Sili broke twenty thousand rebels at Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Sili routed twenty thousand rebels at Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，郭子儀收魏州，得偽署刺史蕭華於州獄，詔復以華為刺史。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the eleventh month Guo Ziyi recovered Weizhou and found the false-appointed prefect Xiao Hua in the prison; an edict restored Hua as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Guo Ziyi retook Weizhou and found Xiao Hua, the rebel-appointed prefect, in the jail; the court reappointed him.

sentences.zh: 是日，上皇至自華清宮，上迎於灞上。

translations.literal: That day the Retired Emperor returned from Huaqing Palace; the emperor welcomed him at Ba River.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Retired Emperor returned from Huaqing Palace; the emperor met him at Ba River.

sentences.zh: 上自控上皇馬轡百餘步，誥止之，乃已。

translations.literal: The emperor himself held the Retired Emperor's reins for more than a hundred paces; only after repeated admonition did he stop.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor walked his father's horse by the reins for more than a hundred paces before repeated pleas made him stop.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，以河南節度崔光遠為魏州刺史，遣蕭華赴相州行營。

translations.literal: On guimao of the twelfth month Cui Guangyuan, Henan military commissioner, was made prefect of Wei; Xiao Hua was sent to the Xiangzhou field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Cui Guangyuan, Henan commissioner, became prefect of Wei; Xiao Hua was sent to the Xiangzhou headquarters.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以升州刺史韋黃裳為蘇州刺史、浙西節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Sheng prefect Wei Huangshang was made prefect of Su and military commissioner of western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wei Huangshang, Sheng prefect, became Su prefect and western Zhejiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以戶部尚書李峘充淮南、浙西觀察使、處置節度使。

translations.literal: On gengxu Minister of Revenue Li Kun was made Huainan and western Zhejiang surveillance commissioner and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Li Kun, minister of revenue, was made surveillance and disposition commissioner for Huainan and western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，立春，上御宣政殿，讀時令，常參官五品已上升殿序坐而聽之。

translations.literal: On bingyin, at the Beginning of Spring, the emperor took Xuanzheng Hall, read the season's ordinances, and regular officials of fifth rank and above ascended the hall in order and listened.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Beginning of Spring, the emperor read the seasonal ordinances at Xuanzheng Hall while officials of fifth rank and above took their seats to listen.

sentences.zh: 時王師圍相州，慶緒食盡，求於史思明，率眾來援。

translations.literal: At that time the imperial army besieged Xiangzhou; Qingxu's provisions were exhausted and he begged Shi Siming, who led his host to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: While the imperial army besieged Xiangzhou, Qingxu's stores ran out; he called on Shi Siming, who marched to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，思明復陷魏州，刺史崔光遠出奔。

translations.literal: On dingmao Siming again took Weizhou; prefect Cui Guangyuan fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Siming retook Weizhou and Prefect Cui Guangyuan fled.

sentences.zh: 乾元二年二年春正月己巳朔，上御含元殿，受尊號曰乾元大聖光天文武孝感皇帝。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianyuan, spring, first month, on the jisi new moon the emperor took Hanyuan Hall and received the honorific Qianyuan Great Sage, Luminous Heaven, Cultured in War, Filially Attentive Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of spring in Qianyuan 2 the emperor took Hanyuan Hall and received the honorific Qianyuan Great Sage, Luminous Heaven, Cultured in War, Filially Attentive Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日，史思明自稱燕王於魏州，僭立年號。

translations.literal: That day Shi Siming declared himself King of Yan at Weizhou and presumptuously established an era name.
translations.idiomatic: That day Shi Siming proclaimed himself King of Yan at Weizhou and usurped an era name.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上親祀九宮貴神，齋宿於壇所。

translations.literal: On dingchou the emperor personally sacrificed to the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits and fasted at the altar site.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the emperor sacrificed in person to the Nine Palaces spirits and kept vigil at the altar.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，有事於籍田，上行九推，禮官奏太過，上曰：「朕勸農率下，所恨不終千畝耳。

translations.literal: On wuyin he performed the plowing rites at the sacred field; the emperor performed nine furrows; the ritual officials reported it excessive, and the emperor said: "I lead the realm in urging agriculture—my only regret is that I did not finish a thousand mu."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he plowed the sacred field, opening nine furrows; ritual officers said it was too much, but the emperor replied, "I urge the farmers on—my only regret is not finishing a thousand mu."

sentences.zh: 」癸未夜，月掩歲星。

translations.literal: On the night of guiwei the moon occulted the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiwei the moon passed before the Year Star.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以御史中丞崔寓都統浙江、淮南節度處置使。

translations.literal: On yichou Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Yu was made overall commander of Zhejiang and Huainan military disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Cui Yu, vice censor-in-chief, was made overall commander for Zhejiang and Huainan disposition.

sentences.zh: 丙申，開府儀同三司、衛尉卿、懷州北庭行營節度使、虢國公李嗣業卒於相州行營。

translations.literal: On bingshen Kai fu, Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and Northern Court field headquarters commissioner Li Siye, Duke of Guo, died at the Xiangzhou field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Siye, kai fu, minister of the imperial stud, Northern Court commissioner, and Duke of Guo, died at the Xiangzhou headquarters.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以太子少師崔圓充東京留守，判尚書省事。

translations.literal: On gengzi junior preceptor of the heir apparent Cui Yuan was made Eastern Capital regent and acting director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Cui Yuan, junior preceptor of the heir apparent, became Eastern Capital regent and acting head of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子望，月蝕既。

translations.literal: On the full moon of the second month, renzi, there was a total lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi full moon of the second month the moon was totally eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 百官請加皇后張氏尊號曰「翊聖」，上以月蝕陰德不修而止。

translations.literal: The hundred officials asked to add to Empress Zhang the honorific "Assisting Sage"; because of the lunar eclipse the emperor stopped it, saying yin virtue was not cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: Officials petitioned to add Assisting Sage to Empress Zhang's title; the emperor refused, citing the eclipse as a sign that yin virtue had not been perfected.

sentences.zh: 貶東京留守、嗣虢王巨以遂州刺史，苛政也。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital regent and heir to Prince of Guo Li Ju was demoted to prefect of Suizhou for harsh government.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ju, Eastern Capital regent and heir to Prince of Guo, was demoted to Suizhou prefect for harsh rule.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，月犯心大星。

translations.literal: On bingchen the moon violated the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the moon transgressed the Heart's great star.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣侍中苗晉卿、王璵分錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On renxu Chief Minister Miao Jinqing and Wang Yu were sent separately to record prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Miao Jinqing and Wang Yu were dispatched separately to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯朔。

translations.literal: Third month, dingmao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the third month.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇后祀先蠶於苑中。

translations.literal: On jisi the empress sacrificed to the Silkworm Ancestor in the park.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the empress offered to the Silkworm Ancestor in the imperial park.

sentences.zh: 壬申，相州行營郭子儀等與賊史思明戰，王師不利，九節度兵潰，子儀斷河陽橋，以餘眾保東京。

translations.literal: On renshen at the Xiangzhou field headquarters Guo Ziyi and others fought the rebel Shi Siming; the imperial army was unfavorable, the nine commissioners' troops routed; Ziyi cut the Heyang Bridge and with the remnant guarded the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen at Xiangzhou Guo Ziyi and the nine commissioners met Shi Siming and were defeated; Ziyi burned the Heyang Bridge and withdrew the survivors to guard Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以衛尉卿荔非元禮為懷州刺史，權鎮西、北庭行營節度使；

translations.literal: On xinmao Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Li Feiyuanli was made prefect of Huai and acting commissioner of the Western and Northern Court field headquarters;
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Feiyuanli, minister of the imperial stud, became Huai prefect and acting commissioner of the Western and Northern Court headquarters;

sentences.zh: 以滑州刺史許叔冀充滑、汴、曹、宋等州節度使；

translations.literal: Hua prefect Xu Shuji was made military commissioner of Hua, Bian, Cao, and Song;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shuji, Hua prefect, took command of Hua, Bian, Cao, and Song;

sentences.zh: 以鄆州刺史尚衡為徐州刺史，充亳、潁等州節度使。

translations.literal: Yan prefect Shang Heng was made prefect of Xu and military commissioner of Bo and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Heng, Yan prefect, became Xu prefect and commissioner of Bo and Ying.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以兵部侍郎呂諲同中書門下平章事，以太子賓客薛景仙為鳳翔尹、本府防禦使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Vice Minister of War Lü Yin was made associate director of the Chancellery; heir-apparent guest Xue Jingxian was made Fengxiang intendant and defender of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Lü Yin, vice minister of war, joined the council; Xue Jingxian, heir-apparent guest, became Fengxiang intendant and defender.

sentences.zh: 乙未，侍中苗晉卿為太子太傅，平章事王璵為刑部尚書，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: On yiwei Chief Minister Miao Jinqing was made grand tutor of the heir apparent; associate director Wang Yu minister of justice—both were removed from active governance.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Miao Jinqing became grand tutor of the heir apparent; Wang Yu, associate director, minister of justice—both left the council.

sentences.zh: 以京兆尹李峴為吏部尚書，禮部侍郎李揆為中書侍郎，與戶部侍郎第五琦等並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Capital intendant Li Xian was made minister of personnel; Vice Minister of Rites Li Kui vice director of the Secretariat—together with Vice Minister of Revenue Diwu Qi they all became associate directors of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xian, capital intendant, became minister of personnel; Li Kui, vice minister of rites, vice director of the Secretariat; Diwu Qi, vice minister of revenue—all joined the council.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以郭子儀為東畿、山南東、河南等道節度、防禦兵馬元帥，權東京留守，判尚書省事。

translations.literal: On bingshen Guo Ziyi was made military commissioner and commander of the armies of the Eastern Capital circuit, Shannan East, Henan, and the rest, with acting Eastern Capital regency and direction of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Guo Ziyi was made commander of the Eastern Capital, Shannan East, and Henan armies, acting Eastern Capital regent, and head of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以河西節度副使來瑱為陜州刺史，充虢華節度、潼關防禦團練等使。

translations.literal: Hedong deputy commissioner Lai Tian was made prefect of Shaan and military commissioner of Guo and Hua, with defense and training of Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Tian, Hedong deputy commissioner, became Shaan prefect, commissioner of Guo and Hua, and defender of Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 四月丁酉朔，王思禮奏於潞城縣東直千嶺破賊萬人。

translations.literal: On the dingyou new moon of the fourth month Wang Sili memorialized that at Zhigan Ridge east of Lucheng county he had broken ten thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon Wang Sili reported breaking ten thousand rebels at Zhigan Ridge east of Lucheng.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔以寇孽未平，務懷捴挹，「自今以後，朕常膳及服御等物，並從節減，諸作坊造坊並停」。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict said that because the rebel scourge was not yet pacified, one must cherish restraint: "From now on, my daily meals and robes and furnishings shall all be reduced; every workshop and manufacturing office is halted."
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict declared that with the rebels still abroad the court must practice restraint: "Henceforth my table and wardrobe shall be cut back, and every imperial workshop shall cease."

sentences.zh: 「比緣軍國務殷，或宣口敕處分。

translations.literal: "Recently, because military and state affairs were pressing, oral commands were sometimes issued for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: "Lately military urgency has led to oral commands bypassing regular channels.

sentences.zh: 今後非正宣，並不得行用，中外諸務，各歸有司。

translations.literal: Henceforth what is not a formal proclamation may not be carried out; inside and outside, every affair returns to its proper office."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth nothing but formal edicts may govern; every affair, within and without, belongs to its proper office."

sentences.zh: 英武軍及六軍諸使，比因論竟便行追攝。

translations.literal: The Heroic Martial Army and the Six Armies and their commissioners—because of disputes they have often carried out arrests on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: The Heroic Martial Army and the Six Armies have often arrested men on their own authority after quarrels.

sentences.zh: 今後須經臺府，如處斷不平，具狀聞奏。

translations.literal: Henceforth they must go through the censorate; if judgment is unfair, memorialize with the facts."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth they must act through the censorate; if punishment seems unjust, report the facts to the throne."

sentences.zh: 自文武五品已上正官各舉賢良方正、直言極諫一人，任自封進。

translations.literal: Every incumbent civil and military official of fifth rank and above in regular post may each recommend one man of worth, integrity, and forthright remonstrance, who may present himself with a sealed memorial."
translations.idiomatic: Every regular official of fifth rank and above may recommend one candidate of worth, integrity, and bold counsel, who may submit a sealed memorial in his own name.

sentences.zh: 兩省官十日一上封事。

translations.literal: Officials of the two secretariats shall every ten days submit a sealed memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat officials shall submit sealed memorials every ten days.

sentences.zh: 御史臺欲彈事，不須進狀，仍服豸冠。

translations.literal: When the Censorate wishes to impeach, it need not submit a preliminary memorial and shall again wear the xie crown."
translations.idiomatic: When censors impeach, they need not file a preliminary petition and shall again wear the xie crown.

sentences.zh: 殘妖未殄，國步猶難，共體至公，以康庶政。

translations.literal: The remnant rebels are not yet destroyed and the realm's step is still hard—let all embody utmost fairness to bring peace to government.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels are not yet destroyed and the realm still staggers—let all embrace utmost fairness to heal governance.

sentences.zh: 朕推誠御物，與眾共之，思與蒼生，臻夫至道。

translations.literal: I rule with open heart and share with the multitude; I desire with the living people to reach the utmost Way.
translations.idiomatic: I rule with an open heart and share power with all; I desire with the people to reach the utmost Way.

sentences.zh: 宣示中外，知朕意焉。

translations.literal: 」Let this be proclaimed inside and outside, that all may know my intent."
translations.idiomatic: [Close of edict.] Let this be proclaimed within and without, that all may know my mind."

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，以鄧州刺史魯炅為鄭州刺史，充陳、鄭、潁、亳節度使；

translations.literal: On jiachen Deng prefect Lu Qiong was made Zheng prefect and military commissioner of Chen, Zheng, Ying, and Bo;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Lu Qiong, Deng prefect, became Zheng prefect and commissioner of Chen, Zheng, Ying, and Bo;

sentences.zh: 以徐州刺史尚衡為青州刺史，充青、淄、密、登、萊、沂、海等州節度使；

translations.literal: Xu prefect Shang Heng was made Qing prefect and military commissioner of Qing, Zi, Mi, Deng, Lai, Yi, and Hai;
translations.idiomatic: Shang Heng, Xu prefect, became Qing prefect and commissioner of Qing, Zi, Mi, Deng, Lai, Yi, and Hai;

sentences.zh: 以商州刺史、興平軍節度李奐兼豫、許、汝等州節度使。

translations.literal: Shang prefect and Xingping military commissioner Li Huan was made concurrent military commissioner of Yu, Xu, and Ru.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan, Shang prefect and Xingping commissioner, also took Yu, Xu, and Ru.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，第五琦依舊判度支、租庸等使。

translations.literal: On yisi Diwu Qi resumed his former posts as commissioner of the treasury and tax and corvée bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Diwu Qi resumed charge of the treasury and tax and corvée bureaus.

sentences.zh: 史思明僭號於魏州。

translations.literal: Shi Siming usurped an era title at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Siming proclaimed a reign title at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 貶季廣琛宣州刺史。

translations.literal: Ji Guangchen was demoted to prefect of Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Guangchen was demoted to Xuan prefect.

sentences.zh: 崔光遠為太子少保。

translations.literal: Cui Guangyuan was made junior grand protector of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Guangyuan became junior grand protector of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以久旱徙市，雩祈雨。

translations.literal: On guihai, because of long drought, the market was moved and rain was sought by the yu rite.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai prolonged drought led to moving the market and performing rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，貶宰相李峴蜀州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinsi Chancellor Li Xian was demoted to prefect of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Xian, chancellor, was demoted to Shu prefect.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上御宣政殿試文經邦國等四科舉人。

translations.literal: On dinghai the emperor took Xuanzheng Hall and tested candidates in the four categories of literary classics and statecraft.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor tested candidates in the four literary and statecraft categories at Xuanzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 乃以汝州刺史劉展為滑州刺史，以平盧軍節度都知兵馬使董秦為濮州刺史。

translations.literal: Ru prefect Liu Zhan was made Hua prefect; Dong Qin, Pinglu army commissioner knowing military affairs, was made Pu prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhan, Ru prefect, became Hua prefect; Dong Qin, Pinglu army commissioner, Pu prefect.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未朔，以右僕射裴冕為御史大夫、成都尹，持節充劍南節度副大使、本道觀察使；

translations.literal: On the yiwei new moon of the sixth month Right Vice Director Pei Mian was made censor-in-chief, Chengdu intendant, and deputy military commissioner of Jiannan with surveillance of that circuit;
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon Pei Mian, right vice director, became censor-in-chief, Chengdu intendant, and Jiannan deputy commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以邠州刺史房琯為太子賓客；

translations.literal: Bin prefect Fang Guan was made heir-apparent guest;
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guan, Bin prefect, became heir-apparent guest;

sentences.zh: 以饒州刺史顏真卿為升州刺史，充浙江西道節度使。

translations.literal: Raozhou prefect Yan Zhenqing was made Sheng prefect and military commissioner of western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhenqing, Raozhou prefect, became Sheng prefect and western Zhejiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 已巳，以明州刺史呂延之為越州刺史，充浙江東道節度使；

translations.literal: On jisi Ming prefect Lü Yanzhi was made Yue prefect and military commissioner of eastern Zhejiang;
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Lü Yanzhi, Ming prefect, became Yue prefect and eastern Zhejiang commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以右羽林大將軍彭元曜為鄭州刺史，充陳、鄭、申、光、壽等州節度使。

translations.literal: Right Feathered Forest Grand General Peng Yuanyao was made Zheng prefect and military commissioner of Chen, Zheng, Shen, Guang, and Shou.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yuanyao, right feathered forest grand general, became Zheng prefect and commissioner of Chen, Zheng, Shen, Guang, and Shou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，以禮部尚書韋陟充東京留守。

translations.literal: On the yichou new moon of the seventh autumn month Minister of Rites Wei Zhi was made Eastern Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon Wei Zhi, minister of rites, became Eastern Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 太子少傅、兗國公李麟卒。

translations.literal: Junior grand tutor of the heir apparent and Duke of Yan Li Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Lin, junior grand tutor of the heir apparent and Duke of Yan, died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，制以趙王系為天下兵馬元帥，司空兼侍中李光弼為副。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict made Prince of Zhao Li Xi commander-in-chief of the realm's armies, with Grand Steward and Chief Minister Li Guangbi as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Xi, Prince of Zhao, was named commander-in-chief of all armies, with Li Guangbi, grand steward and chief minister, as deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以兵部尚書、潞州大都督府長史、潞沁節度、霍國公王思禮兼太原尹，充北京留守、河東節度副大使。

translations.literal: On dinghai Minister of War, grand protector of Luzhou, Luzhou and Qin military commissioner, and Duke of Huo Wang Sili was made concurrent Taiyuan intendant, Northern Capital regent, and deputy military commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wang Sili, minister of war, Luzhou grand protector, and Duke of Huo, also became Taiyuan intendant, Northern Capital regent, and Hedong deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書王璵為蒲州刺史，充蒲、同、絳三州節度使。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Wang Yu was made prefect of Pu and military commissioner of Pu, Tong, and Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yu, minister of justice, became Pu prefect and commissioner of Pu, Tong, and Jiang.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，襄州偏將康楚元逐刺史王政，據城自守。

translations.literal: On yihai of the eighth month Xiangzhou deputy general Kang Chuyuan expelled prefect Wang Zheng and held the city in self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Kang Chuyuan, Xiangzhou deputy general, drove out Prefect Wang Zheng and held the city.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，寧國公主自回紇還宮。

translations.literal: On bingchen Princess Ningguo returned from the Uyghurs to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Princess Ningguo returned from the Uyghurs to court.

sentences.zh: 副元帥李光弼兼幽州大都督府長史、河北節度等使。

translations.literal: Deputy commander-in-chief Li Guangbi was made concurrent grand protector of Youzhou and military commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangbi, deputy commander-in-chief, also became grand protector of Youzhou and Hebei commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，襄州賊張嘉延襲破荊州，澧、朗、復、郢、硤、歸等州官吏皆棄城奔竄。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the ninth month the Xiangzhou rebel Zhang Jiayan stormed and took Jingzhou; officials of Li, Lang, Fu, E, Xia, and Gui all abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhang Jiayan of Xiangzhou seized Jingzhou; officials across Li, Lang, Fu, E, Xia, and Gui abandoned their posts and fled.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，新鑄大錢，文如乾元重寶，而重其輪，用一當五十，以二十二斤成貫。

translations.literal: On wuchen new heavy coin was cast, bearing the inscription like Qianyuan Heavy Treasure but with a heavier rim, valued at fifty; twenty-two jin made one string.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen new heavy coin was cast—like Qianyuan Heavy Treasure but with a thicker rim, fifty to one; twenty-two pounds per string.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以太子少保崔光遠充荊、襄等州招討使，右羽林大將軍王仲升充申、安、沔等州節度使，右羽林將軍李抱玉為鄭州刺史、鄭陳潁亳四州節度使。

translations.literal: On dinghai junior grand protector Cui Guangyuan was made pacification commissioner of Jing, Xiang, and other circuits; Right Feathered Forest Grand General Wang Zhongsheng military commissioner of Shen, An, and Mian; Right Feathered Forest General Li Baoyu prefect of Zheng and commissioner of Zheng, Chen, Ying, and Bo.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Cui Guangyuan was made pacification commissioner of Jing and Xiang; Wang Zhongsheng, right feathered forest grand general, commissioner of Shen, An, and Mian; Li Baoyu, right feathered forest general, Zheng prefect and commissioner of Zheng, Chen, Ying, and Bo.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，逆胡史思明陷洛陽，副元帥李光弼守河陽，汝、鄭、滑等州陷賊。

translations.literal: On gengyin the rebel barbarian Shi Siming took Luoyang; deputy commander-in-chief Li Guangbi held Heyang; Ru, Zheng, and Hua fell to the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Shi Siming seized Luoyang; Li Guangbi held Heyang; Ru, Zheng, and Hua fell.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，制親征史思明，竟不行。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the tenth winter month an edict ordered the emperor to campaign in person against Shi Siming; in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict announced a personal campaign against Shi Siming; it was never launched.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，李光弼奏破賊於城下。

translations.literal: On yisi Li Guangbi memorialized that rebels had been broken below the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Guangbi reported breaking rebels beneath the walls.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，宰相呂諲起復，依前平章事。

translations.literal: On renxu Chancellor Lü Yin was recalled to service and again associate director.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Lü Yin was recalled to the council.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子朔，商州刺史韋倫破康楚元，荊襄平。

translations.literal: On the jiazi new moon of the eleventh month Shang prefect Wei Lun broke Kang Chuyuan; Jing and Xiang were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon Wei Lun, Shang prefect, defeated Kang Chuyuan and pacified Jing and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，戶部侍郎、同平章事第五琦貶忠州長史，御史大夫賀蘭進明貶溱州司馬。

translations.literal: On gengwu Vice Minister of Revenue and associate director Diwu Qi was demoted to chief administrator of Zhong; Censor-in-Chief Helan Jinming demoted to army adjutant of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Diwu Qi, vice minister of revenue and associate director, was demoted to Zhong chief administrator; Helan Jinming, censor-in-chief, to Qin army adjutant.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳朔，神策將軍衛伯玉破賊於陜東強子阪。

translations.literal: On the guisi new moon of the twelfth month Shence General Wei Boyu broke rebels at Qiangzi Slope east of Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon Wei Boyu, Shence general, routed rebels at Qiangzi Slope east of Shaan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以御史大夫史翽為襄州刺史，充山南東道節度、觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On jiayin Censor-in-Chief Shi Hong was made prefect of Xiang and military commissioner of Shannan East with surveillance and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Shi Hong, censor-in-chief, became Xiang prefect and Shannan East commissioner with full surveillance powers.

sentences.zh: 上元元年三年春正月癸亥朔。

translations.literal: On the guihai new moon of spring in the third year of Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of spring in Shangyuan 1.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李光弼進位太尉、兼中書令，餘如故。

translations.literal: On xinsi Li Guangbi was advanced to grand marshal and concurrent director of the Secretariat—the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Guangbi was promoted to grand marshal and director of the Secretariat; other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 以杭州刺史侯令儀為升州刺史，充浙江西道節度兼江寧軍使。

translations.literal: Hangzhou prefect Hou Lingyi was made Sheng prefect and military commissioner of western Zhejiang with command of the Jiangning army.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Lingyi, Hangzhou prefect, became Sheng prefect, western Zhejiang commissioner, and commander of the Jiangning army.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以朔方節度使郭子儀兼邠寧、鄜坊兩道節度使。

translations.literal: On wuzi Shuofang military commissioner Guo Ziyi was made concurrent military commissioner of Binning and Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Guo Ziyi, Shuofang commissioner, also took Binning and Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳朔，以右丞崔寓為蒲州刺史，充蒲、同、晉、絳等州節度使。

translations.literal: On the guisi new moon of the second month Right Vice Director Cui Yu was made prefect of Pu and military commissioner of Pu, Tong, Jin, and Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon Cui Yu, right vice director, became Pu prefect and commissioner of Pu, Tong, Jin, and Jiang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，第五琦除名，長流夷州。

translations.literal: On gengxu Diwu Qi was stripped of name and long exiled to Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Diwu Qi was disgraced and exiled to Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以太子少保崔光遠為鳳翔尹、秦隴節度使。

translations.literal: On guichou junior grand protector Cui Guangyuan was made Fengxiang intendant and Qin-Long military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Cui Guangyuan, junior grand protector, became Fengxiang intendant and Qin-Long commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，以京兆尹李若幽為成都尹、劍南節度使。

translations.literal: On renshen of the third month capital intendant Li Ruoyou was made Chengdu intendant and Jiannan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Ruoyou, capital intendant, became Chengdu intendant and Jiannan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以蒲州為河中府，其州縣官吏所置，同京兆、河南二府。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Puzhou was made Hezhong Prefecture; its prefectural and county officials and appointments were equated with those of the two metropolitan prefectures of Jingzhao and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Puzhou became Hezhong Prefecture, with magistrates and staff ranked like Chang'an and Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 四月甲午，李光弼奏破賊於懷州、河陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on jiawu, Li Guangbi memorialized victory over rebels at Huai and Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Guangbi reported breaking the rebels at Huai and Heyang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以禮部尚書、東京留守韋陟為吏部尚書，太子賓客房琯為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Minister of Rites and Eastern Capital Regent Wei Zhi was made Minister of Personnel; Heir Apparent Guest of Ceremonies Fang Guan was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wei Zhi moved from Rites to Personnel and Fang Guan from the heir's household to Rites.

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客、平章事張鎬為左散騎常侍，太子賓客崔渙為大理卿。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Guest of Ceremonies and Grand Councillor Zhang Hao was made Left Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant-in-Chief; Heir Apparent Guest of Ceremonies Cui Huan was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hao became left supernumerary cavalier; Cui Huan became chief of judicial review.

sentences.zh: 是歲饑，米斗至一千五百文。

translations.literal: That year there was famine; rice reached one thousand five hundred cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Famine drove rice to fifteen hundred cash the dou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，襄州軍亂，殺節度使史翽，部將張維瑾據州叛。

translations.literal: On wushen the Xiangzhou army mutinied, killed Military Commissioner Shi Hui, and Subordinate General Zhang Weijin seized the prefecture in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xiangzhou troops killed Shi Hui and Zhang Weijin rebelled and held the city.

sentences.zh: 丁巳夜，彗出東方，在婁、胃間，長四尺許。

translations.literal: On the night of dingsi a comet appeared in the east between the Lodging and Stomach mansions, about four chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi night brought a four-chi comet east between Lodging and Stomach.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以右丞蕭華為河中尹、兼御史中丞，充同、晉、絳等州節度、觀察處置使。

translations.literal: On wuwu Right Vice Director Xiao Hua was made Hezhong Intendant and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, with commission as military commissioner and observation commissioner of Tong, Jin, Jiang, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Xiao Hua became Hezhong intendant and commissioner over Tong, Jin, Jiang, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 己未，以陜州刺史來瑱為襄州刺史，充山南東道襄鄧等十州節度、觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On jiwei Shaanxi Prefecture Inspector Lai Zhen was made Xiangzhou Prefect and military commissioner of ten prefectures of the southeastern Shannan circuit including Xiang and Deng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Lai Zhen took Xiangzhou and ten southeastern Shannan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以右羽林大將軍郭英乂為陜州刺史、陜西節度、潼關防禦等使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Right Feathered Forest Grand General Guo Yingyi was made Shaanxi Prefect and Shaanxi military commissioner and Tong Pass defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Guo Yingyi became Shaanxi prefect and Tong Pass defender.

sentences.zh: 閏四月辛酉朔，彗出西方，其長數丈。

translations.literal: On the xinyou new moon of the intercalary fourth month a comet appeared in the west several zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: The intercalary fourth month opened with a western comet many zhang long.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以禮部尚書房琯為晉州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu Minister of Rites Fang Guan was made Jinzhou Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Fang Guan was sent to Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，制彭王僅充河西節度大使，兗王僴北庭節度大使，涇王侹隴右節度大使，杞王倕陜西節度大使，興王佋鳳翔節度大使，蜀王偲邠寧節度大使，並不出閣。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict made Prince of Peng Jin Grand Military Commissioner of the Hexi circuit, Prince of Yan Qian Grand Military Commissioner of Beiting, Prince of Jing You Longyou, Prince of Qi Chun Shaanxi, Prince of Xing Zhao Fengxiang, and Prince of Shu Si Binning—all without leaving the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi six princes were named grand commissioners of the western circuits but kept within the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太原尹王思禮進位司空。

translations.literal: On dingmao Taiyuan Intendant Wang Sili was promoted to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wang Sili of Taiyuan became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，天下兵馬元帥、趙王系改封越王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Prince of Zhao Xi, supreme commander of all armies, was re-enfeoffed Prince of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Prince of Zhao Xi became Prince of Yue.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以星文變異，上御明鳳門，大赦天下，改乾元為上元。

translations.literal: On jimao, because of strange stars in the sky, the emperor went to Mingfeng Gate, proclaimed a great amnesty, and changed the era from Qianyuan to Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao omens drove him to Mingfeng Gate for amnesty and the era became Shangyuan.

sentences.zh: 追封周太公望為武成王，依文宣王例置廟。

translations.literal: Duke Taigong Wang of Zhou was posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Martial Accomplishment, with a temple established by the precedent of Duke Wenxuan of Culture.
translations.idiomatic: Taigong Wang of Zhou was enfeoffed Duke of Martial Accomplishment with a temple like Confucius.

sentences.zh: 時大霧，自四月雨至閏月末不止。

translations.literal: At that time dense fog hung; from the fourth month rain fell without cease through the intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: Great fog and rain from the fourth month through the intercalary month never stopped.

sentences.zh: 米價翔貴，人相食，餓死者委骸於路。

translations.literal: Rice soared in price; men ate one another, and the starved lay heaped on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Rice soared; cannibalism spread and corpses choked the roads.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以刑部尚書王璵為太常卿，右散騎常侍韓擇木為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On renwu Minister of Justice Wang Yu was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Right Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant-in-Chief Han Zelin was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Wang Yu took the sacrifices directorate and Han Zelin took Rites.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on gengyin the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以太子太傅、韓國公苗晉卿為侍中。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Han Miao Jinqing was made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Miao Jinqing became palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬子，黃門侍郎、同中書門下三品呂諲為太子賓客，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On renzi Yellow Gate Vice Director and Grand Councillor of the third rank Lü Yin was made Heir Apparent Guest of Ceremonies and removed from governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Lü Yin left the council for the heir's household.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以河南尹劉晏為戶部侍郎，勾當度支、鑄錢、鹽鐵等使。

translations.literal: On guichou Henan Intendant Liu Yan was made Vice Minister of Revenue and charged with revenue, coinage, and salt-iron affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Yan took Revenue and the salt-iron portfolio.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月掩昴。

translations.literal: That night the moon occulted the Hairy Head constellation.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon covered Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，詔先鑄重棱錢一當五十，宜減當三十文；

translations.literal: In the sixth month on yichou an edict ordered that the newly cast heavy-rim coins worth fifty be reduced to thirty;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month heavy fifty-cash coins were cut to thirty;

sentences.zh: 開元宜一當十。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan coins should pass at ten.
translations.idiomatic: and Kaiyuan coins at ten.

sentences.zh: 七月己丑朔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on jichou the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on jichou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上皇自興慶宮移居西內。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Retired Emperor moved from Xingqing Palace to the western inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the retired emperor left Xingqing for the western palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，開府高力士配流巫州；

translations.literal: On bingchen Opening Office Director Gao Lishi was banished to Wuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Gao Lishi was exiled to Wuzhou;

sentences.zh: 內侍王承恩流播州，魏悅流溱州；

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Wang Chengen to Bozhou, Wei Yue to Qinzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengen to Bo, Wei Yue to Qin;

sentences.zh: 左龍武大將軍陳玄禮致仕。

translations.literal: Left Dragon Martial Grand General Chen Xuanli retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: and Chen Xuanli of the Dragon Martial Guard retired.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，御史大夫崔器卒。

translations.literal: On bingchen Censor-in-Chief Cui Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: That same bingchen day Censor-in-Chief Cui Qi died.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，吏部尚書韋陟卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on xinwei Minister of Personnel Wei Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wei Zhi of Personnel died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太子賓客呂諲為荊州大都督府長史、澧朗硤忠五州節度觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On dingchou Heir Apparent Guest of Ceremonies Lü Yin was made Grand Protector of Jingzhou and military commissioner of Li, Lang, Xia, Zhong, and five other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Lü Yin became Jingzhou protector over five river prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以將作監王昂為河中尹、本府晉絳等州節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao Director of Palace Construction Wang Ang was made Hezhong Intendant and military commissioner of Jin and Jiang in that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Wang Ang took Hezhong and its Jin-Jiang command.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，贈故興王佋為恭懿太子。

translations.literal: On dinghai the late Prince of Xing Zhao was posthumously enfeoffed Respectful and Graceful Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the late Prince Zhao was named Respectful and Graceful Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，以荊州為南都，州曰江陵府，官吏制置同京兆。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiawu Jingzhou was made the southern capital, the prefecture called Jiangling Prefecture, and official appointments equated with Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jingzhou became southern capital Jiangling, ranked with Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 其蜀郡先為南京，宜復為蜀郡。

translations.literal: Shu Commandery, formerly the southern capital, should revert to Shu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Shu, once southern capital, reverted to Shu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，以廬州刺史趙良弼為越州刺史，充浙江東道節度使；

translations.literal: In the tenth month on renshen Luzhou Prefecture Inspector Zhao Liangbi was made Yuezhou Prefect and Zhejiang East Circuit military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhao Liangbi became Yue prefect and Zhejiang East commissioner;

sentences.zh: 青州刺史殷仲卿為淄州刺史、淄沂滄德棣等州節度使。

translations.literal: Qingzhou Prefecture Inspector Yin Zhongqing was made Zi Prefect and military commissioner of Zi, Yi, Cang, De, Di, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhongqing became Zi prefect over the eastern Shandong coast.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以兵部侍郎尚衡為青州刺史、青登等州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiashen Vice Minister of War Shang Heng was made Qingzhou Prefect and military commissioner of Qing, Deng, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Shang Heng took Qingzhou and the Deng coast.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，李光弼奏收懷州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on yisi Li Guangbi memorialized recovery of Huai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Li Guangbi reported Huai Prefecture retaken.

sentences.zh: 宋州刺史劉展赴鎮揚州，揚州長史鄧景山以兵拒之，為展所敗，展進陷揚、潤、升等州。

translations.literal: Songzhou Prefecture Inspector Liu Zhan went to take up his post at Yangzhou; Yangzhou Chief Administrator Deng Jingshan resisted with troops and was defeated; Zhan advanced and seized Yang, Run, Sheng, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhan marched on Yangzhou, beat Deng Jingshan, and seized Yang, Run, and Sheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，以右羽林軍大將軍李鼎為鳳翔尹、興鳳隴等州節度使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on gengchen Right Feathered Forest Army Grand General Li Ding was made Fengxiang Intendant and military commissioner of Xing, Feng, and Long prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Ding became Fengxiang intendant over Longyou.

sentences.zh: 癸未夜，歲星掩房。

translations.literal: On the night of guiwei the Year Star occulted the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Guiwei night the Year Star covered Room.

sentences.zh: 上元二年二年春正月丁亥朔。

translations.literal: In spring of the first month of the second year of Shangyuan, on dinghai the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyuan 2 opened in spring on dinghai.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，溫州刺史季廣琛為宣州刺史，充浙江西道節度使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Wenzhou Prefecture Inspector Ji Guangchen was made Xuanzhou Prefect and Zhejiang West Circuit military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Ji Guangchen took Xuanzhou and Zhejiang West.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上不康，皇后張氏刺血寫佛經。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor was unwell; Empress Zhang drew blood to copy a Buddhist sutra.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor fell ill and Empress Zhang copied a sutra in her blood.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔府縣、御史臺、大理疏理系囚，死罪降從流，流已下並釋放。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict ordered prefectures, counties, the Censorate, and the Court of Judicial Review to review prisoners in custody; death sentences were reduced to exile, and those at exile or below were all released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin courts reviewed prisoners: death became exile, lesser crimes freed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，平盧軍兵馬使田神功生擒劉展，揚、潤平。

translations.literal: On yimao Pinglu army commander Tian Shenggong captured Liu Zhan alive; Yang and Run were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Tian Shenggong took Liu Zhan alive and pacified Yang and Run.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，黨項寇寶雞，入散關，陷鳳州，殺刺史蕭心曳，鳳翔李鼎邀擊之。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Tangut raided Baoji, entered San Pass, seized Feng Prefecture, and killed Prefect Xiao Xinyi; Fengxiang Li Ding intercepted them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Tangut raiders took Feng Prefecture and killed Xiao Xinyi until Li Ding of Fengxiang struck back.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以鳳翔尹崔光遠為成都尹、劍南節度、度支營田觀察處置等使，以太子詹事、趙國公崔圓為揚州大都督府長史、淮南節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: On guihai Fengxiang Intendant Cui Guangyuan was made Chengdu Intendant and Jiannan military, revenue, and farming commissioner; Heir Apparent Household Superintendent and Duke of Zhao Cui Yuan was made Grand Protector of Yangzhou and Huainan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Cui Guangyuan went to Chengdu and Cui Yuan to Yangzhou over Huainan.

sentences.zh: 辛未夜，月有蝕之，既。

translations.literal: On the night of xinwei there was a total eclipse of the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Xinwei night brought a total lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，李光弼率河陽之軍五萬，與史思明之眾戰於北邙，官軍敗績。

translations.literal: On wuyin Li Guangbi led fifty thousand troops of Heyang and fought the host of Shi Siming at North Mang; the government army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Guangbi’s fifty thousand met Shi Siming at North Mang and lost.

sentences.zh: 光弼、僕固懷恩走保聞喜，魚朝恩、衛伯玉走保陜州，河陽、懷州共陷賊，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Guangbi and Pugu Huaien fled to defend Wenxi; Yu Chaoen and Wei Boyu fled to defend Shaanxi; Heyang and Huai fell to the rebels, and the capital was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Guangbi and Pugu Huaien fled to Wenxi; Yu Chaoen and Wei Boyu to Shaanxi; Heyang and Huai fell and Chang'an alarmed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，中書侍郎、同中書門下三品李揆貶為袁州長史。

translations.literal: On guiwei Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor Li Kui was demoted to Chief Administrator of Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Kui was demoted to Yuan prefect.

sentences.zh: 以前河中尹蕭華為中書侍郎、同平章事、集賢殿崇文館大學士，兼修國史。

translations.literal: Former Hezhong Intendant Xiao Hua was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and Hall of Cultivated Literature, and charged with compiling the national history.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hezhong intendant Xiao Hua joined the council and took the national history.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，史朝義率眾夜襲我陜州，衛伯玉逆擊，敗之。

translations.literal: In the third month on jiazi Shi Chaoyi led troops in a night raid on our Shaanxi; Wei Boyu met and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Chaoyi raided Shaanxi by night and Wei Boyu beat him off.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，史思明為其子朝義所殺。

translations.literal: On wuxu Shi Siming was killed by his son Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Siming fell to his son Chaoyi’s hand.

sentences.zh: 李光弼以失律讓太尉、中書令，許之，授侍中、河中尹、晉絳等州節度觀察使。

translations.literal: Li Guangbi, for breach of discipline, yielded the posts of Grand Marshal and Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery; permission was granted, and he was made Palace Attendant, Hezhong Intendant, and military commissioner of Jin and Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangbi resigned marshal and chancellor for defeat and took Hezhong and Jin-Jiang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥朔，嗣岐王珍得罪，廢為庶人，於溱州安置。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month on yihai the new moon, Heir Apparent Prince of Qi Zhen was found guilty, degraded to commoner, and settled at Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month: Prince of Qi Zhen was degraded to commoner and sent to Qin.

sentences.zh: 連坐竇如玢、崔昌處斬，駙馬都尉楊洄、薛履謙賜自盡，左散騎常侍張鎬貶辰州司戶長任。

translations.literal: Dou Rubing and Cui Chang were executed by association; Son-in-Law Commandant Yang Hui and Xue Lüqian were granted death by their own hand; Left Supernumerary Cavalier Zhang Hao was demoted to Registrar of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Associates were executed; Yang Hui and Xue Lüqian killed themselves; Zhang Hao was sent to Chen as registrar.

sentences.zh: 己未，以吏部侍郎裴遵慶為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jiwei Vice Minister of Personnel Pei Zunqing was made Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Pei Zunqing joined the council from Personnel.

sentences.zh: 青州刺史尚衡、兗州刺史能元皓並奏破賊。

translations.literal: Qingzhou Prefect Shang Heng and Yanzhou Prefect Neng Yuanhao both memorialized victories over rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Heng of Qing and Neng Yuanhao of Yan both reported rebel victories.

sentences.zh: 壬午，梓州刺史段子璋叛，襲破遂州，殺刺史嗣虢王巨。

translations.literal: On renwu Zizhou Prefect Duan Zizhang rebelled, stormed and took Suizhou, and killed Prefect Heir Apparent Prince of Guo Ju.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Duan Zizhang rebelled, took Suizhou, and killed Prince of Guo Ju.

sentences.zh: 東川節度使李奐戰敗，奔成都。

translations.literal: Dongchuan Military Commissioner Li Huan was defeated in battle and fled to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan of Dongchuan was beaten and fled to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，思明偽將滑州刺史令狐彰以滑州歸朝，授彰御史中丞，依前滑州刺史、滑魏德貝相六州節度使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jiawu rebel general Linghu Zhang of Hua Prefecture surrendered Hua to the court; Zhang was made Vice Censor-in-Chief and continued as Hua Prefect and military commissioner of six prefectures including Hua, Wei, De, Bei, and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Linghu Zhang of Hua surrendered and kept six prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙未，劍南節度使崔光遠率師與李奐擊敗段子璋於綿州，擒子璋殺之。

translations.literal: On yiwei Jiannan Military Commissioner Cui Guangyuan led troops with Li Huan to defeat Duan Zizhang at Mian Prefecture, captured Zizhang, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Cui Guangyuan and Li Huan beat Duan Zizhang at Mian and executed him.

sentences.zh: 綿州平。

translations.literal: Mian Prefecture was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Mian was pacified.

sentences.zh: 李光弼來朝，進位太尉、兼侍中，充河南副元帥，都統河南、淮南、山南東道五道行營節度，鎮臨淮。

translations.literal: Li Guangbi came to court and was promoted Grand Marshal and concurrent Palace Attendant, made Deputy Supreme Commander of Henan, overall commander of the five circuits of Henan, Huainan, and southeastern Shannan, stationed at Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangbi came to court as grand marshal and deputy Henan commander, stationed at Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 北京留守、守司空、太原尹、河東節度副大使、霍國公王思禮卒。

translations.literal: Northern Capital Regent, Acting Minister of Works, Taiyuan Intendant, Hedong Deputy Military Commissioner, and Duke of Huo Wang Sili died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sili of Taiyuan and Hedong died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以鴻臚卿、趙國公管崇嗣為太原尹、兼御史大夫，充北京留守、河東節度副大使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and Duke of Zhao Guan Chongsi was made Taiyuan Intendant and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Northern Capital Regent, and Hedong Deputy Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Guan Chongsi took Taiyuan and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太子少傅、宗正卿李齊物卒。

translations.literal: Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan Li Qiwu died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiwu, heir's tutor and clan director, died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑朔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on guichou the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on guichou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以鳳翔尹李鼎為鄯州刺史、隴右節度營田等使。

translations.literal: On jimao Fengxiang Intendant Li Ding was made Bin Prefect and Longyou military and farming commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Ding went to Bin and Longyou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未朔，日有蝕之，既。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month on guiwei the new moon, there was a total eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn’s seventh month opened with a total eclipse.

sentences.zh: 大星皆見。

translations.literal: Great stars all appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Great stars shone by day.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，延英殿御座梁上生玉芝，一莖三花，上制《玉靈芝詩》。

translations.literal: On jiachen jade fungus of three blooms on one stem grew on a beam of the Yanying Hall; the emperor composed "Ode to the Jade Spirit Fungus."
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen three-bloom jade fungus grew on Yanying Hall and the emperor wrote an ode.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑朔，以中官李輔國守兵部尚書，於尚書省上，命宰臣百官送之，酣宴竟日。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on guichou the new moon, the eunuch Li Fuguo was made Minister of War; at the Ministry he was seen off by councillors and all officials, and feasting lasted the whole day.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened with Li Fuguo made War Minister and fêted all day at the ministry.

sentences.zh: 自七月霖雨，至是方止，墻宇多壞，漉魚道中。

translations.literal: From the seventh month rain had fallen; only now did it stop; walls were largely ruined and fish were netted in the streets.
translations.idiomatic: Rain since the seventh month ended at last; walls crumbled and fish swam the streets.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以殿中監李若幽為戶部尚書，充朔方鎮西北庭陳鄭等州節度使，鎮絳州，賜名國貞。

translations.literal: On xinsi Palace Director Li Ruoyou was made Minister of Revenue and Shuo-fang, northwest, Chen, and Zheng military commissioner, stationed at Jiang Prefecture; he was granted the name Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Ruoyou became Revenue minister and northwest commissioner at Jiang, renamed Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renwu the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on renwu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以太子賓客、集賢殿學士、昌黎伯韓擇木為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On renchen Heir Apparent Guest of Ceremonies and Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies Han Zelin, Baron of Changli, was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Han Zelin of the heir's household took Rites.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制：

translations.literal: On renyin an edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the throne issued an edict.

sentences.zh: 壬申，嗣寧王棣薨。

translations.literal: On renshen Heir Apparent Prince of Ning Di died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Prince of Ning Di died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，河南副元帥李光弼破賊於許州城下，收復許州。

translations.literal: On guiyou Deputy Supreme Commander of Henan Li Guangbi defeated rebels below Xuzhou city and recovered Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Guangbi beat the rebels at Xuzhou and retook the city.

sentences.zh: 建辰月庚辰朔。

translations.literal: In the jian-chen month on gengchen the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The jian-chen month opened on gengchen.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔天下見禁系囚，無輕重一切釋放。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ordered that all prisoners now in custody, regardless of gravity, be released.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu all prisoners in custody were freed regardless of crime.

sentences.zh: 丙戌夜，月有白冠。

translations.literal: On the night of bingxu the moon wore a white corona.
translations.idiomatic: Bingxu night the moon wore a white crown.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以襄州刺史來瑱為安州刺史，充淮西申、安、蘄、黃、沔等十六州節度使。

translations.literal: On guisi Xiangzhou Prefect Lai Zhen was made An Prefect and military commissioner of sixteen Huai-west prefectures including Shen, An, Qi, Huang, and Mian.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Lai Zhen took An and sixteen Huai-west prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲午，黨項奴剌寇梁州，刺史李勉棄郡走。

translations.literal: On jiawu the Tangut chieftain Nuci raided Liang Prefecture; Prefect Li Mian abandoned the commandery and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Tangut Nuci raided Liang and Li Mian fled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，黨項寇奉天。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Tangut raided Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Tangut raiders struck Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 上不康，百僚於佛寺齋僧。

translations.literal: The emperor was unwell; the hundred officials fasted and offered monks at Buddhist temples.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was ill; officials fasted and fed monks at temples.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔左降官、流人一切放還。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict ordered that all demoted and exiled officials be released and restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei all demoted and exiled men were restored.

sentences.zh: 戊申，中書侍郎、平章事、徐國公蕭華為禮部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, and Duke of Xu Xiao Hua was made Minister of Rites and removed from governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hua left the council for Rites.

sentences.zh: 以尚書戶部侍郎元載同中書門下平章事，以禮部尚書韓擇木為太子太保。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Yuan Zai was made Grand Councillor; Minister of Rites Han Zelin was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zai joined the council; Han Zelin became the heir's grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 寶應元年建巳月庚戌朔。

translations.literal: In the jian-si month of Baoying 1 on gengxu the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Baoying 1 opened in the jian-si month on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，楚州刺史崔侁獻定國寶玉十三枚：一曰玄黃天符，如笏，長八寸，闊三寸，上圓下方，近圓有孔，黃玉也。

translations.literal: On renzi Chuzhou Prefecture Inspector Cui Qian presented thirteen treasures of the realm: first, the Black-and-Yellow Heavenly Talisman, like a tablet, eight cun long and three cun wide, round above and square below, nearly round with a hole, of yellow jade.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Cui Qian of Chuzhou offered thirteen state treasures: first, the Black-and-Yellow Heavenly Talisman—tablet-shaped yellow jade, eight by three cun.

sentences.zh: 二曰玉雞，毛文悉備，白玉也。

translations.literal: Second: the jade cock, its feather pattern complete, of white jade.
translations.idiomatic: Second, a white-jade cock with every feather marked.

sentences.zh: 三曰穀璧，白玉也，徑可五六寸，其文粟粒無雕鐫之跡。

translations.literal: Third: the grain disc, of white jade, about five or six cun in diameter, its pattern like millet grains with no trace of carving.
translations.idiomatic: Third came a white-jade grain disc five or six cun wide, millet-patterned and uncarved.

sentences.zh: 四曰西王母白環，二枚，白玉也，徑六七寸。

translations.literal: Fourth: the Queen Mother of the West’s white rings, two pieces, of white jade, six or seven cun in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, two white-jade rings of the Queen Mother of the West, six or seven cun across.

sentences.zh: 五曰碧色寶，圓而有光。

translations.literal: Fifth: the green treasure, round and luminous.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth was a round green gem that shone.

sentences.zh: 六曰如意寶珠，形圓如雞卵，光如月。

translations.literal: Sixth: the wish-fulfilling pearl, round as a hen’s egg, bright as the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, a wish-fulfilling pearl egg-round and moon-bright.

sentences.zh: 七曰紅靺鞨，大如巨慄，赤如櫻桃。

translations.literal: Seventh: red mokling, large as a great chestnut, red as a cherry.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, a red mokling stone big as a chestnut and cherry-red.

sentences.zh: 八曰瑯玕珠，二枚，長一寸二分。

translations.literal: Eighth: langgan pearls, two pieces, one cun two fen long.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, two langgan pearls an inch and two fen long.

sentences.zh: 九曰玉玦，形如玉環，四分缺一。

translations.literal: Ninth: the jade tablet, shaped like a jade ring with one quarter missing.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, a jade tablet like a ring missing a quarter.

sentences.zh: 十曰玉印，大如半手，斜長，理如鹿形，陷入印中，以印物則鹿形著焉。

translations.literal: Tenth: the jade seal, large as half a hand, oblong, its grain like a deer, the deer shape sunk in the seal so that when stamped the deer appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, a palm-half seal oblong-grained like a deer that stamped clear.

sentences.zh: 十一曰皇后採桑鉤，長五六寸，細如箸，屈其末，似真金，又似銀。

translations.literal: Eleventh: the empress’s silkworm-gathering hook, five or six cun long, thin as a chopstick, bent at the tip, seeming true gold and yet seeming silver.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh, the empress’s silkworm hook—chopstick-thin, gold-bright yet silver-pale.

sentences.zh: 十二曰雷公石斧，長四寸，闊二寸，無孔，細致如青玉。

translations.literal: Twelfth: Lord Thunder’s stone axe, four cun long, two cun wide, without a hole, fine as green jade.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth, Lord Thunder’s green-jade axe, four by two cun, holeless.

sentences.zh: 十三寶置於日中，皆白氣連天。

translations.literal: When the thirteen treasures were set in the sun, white vapor joined heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Set in sunlight, all thirteen threw white vapor to the sky.

sentences.zh: 人先表云：「楚州寺尼真如者，恍惚上升，見天帝。

translations.literal: A prior memorial had reported: "At a Chuzhou temple the nun Zhenru in a trance ascended and saw the God on High.
translations.idiomatic: A memorial had told how the Chuzhou nun Zhenru, in trance, rose to the God on High.

sentences.zh: 帝授以十三寶，曰：『中國有災，宜以第二寶鎮之。

translations.literal: The God bestowed thirteen treasures, saying: 'China has calamity; the second treasure should guard it.'
translations.idiomatic: He gave her thirteen treasures, saying China was in calamity and the second should guard the realm.

sentences.zh: 』」甲寅，太上至道聖皇天帝崩於西內神龍殿。

translations.literal: " On jiayin the Retired Emperor of Supreme Way and Sagely Heaven died in the Hall of Divine Dragon in the western inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the retired emperor died in the western palace’s Hall of Divine Dragon.

sentences.zh: 上自仲春不豫，聞上皇登遐，不勝哀悸，因茲大漸。

translations.literal: The emperor had been unwell since mid-spring; hearing of the retired emperor’s passing, he could not bear the grief and his illness sharply worsened.
translations.idiomatic: Ill since mid-spring, he collapsed on news of his father’s death.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On yichou an edict ordered the crown prince to supervise the state.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the crown prince was ordered to govern.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「上天降寶，獻自楚州，因以體元，葉乎五紀。

translations.literal: The edict also said: "Heaven has sent down treasures offered from Chuzhou; therefore take them as the body of the calendar and fit the five reckonings.
translations.idiomatic: The edict went on: heaven’s treasures from Chuzhou would reshape the calendar and the five reckonings.

sentences.zh: 其元年宜改為寶應，建巳月為四月，餘月並依常數，仍依舊以正月一日為歲首。

translations.literal: The first year shall be changed to Baoying; the jiansi month shall be the fourth month; the other months follow the usual count; still, the first day of the first month remains the start of the year.
translations.idiomatic: The era would become Baoying; the intercalary jiansi month would count as fourth; other months unchanged; New Year still the first of the first month.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，宣遺詔。

translations.literal: " On dingmao the testamentary edict was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the death edict was read aloud.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩於長生殿，年五十二。

translations.literal: That day the emperor died in the Hall of Eternal Life at age fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: That day he died in the Hall of Eternal Life, aged fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 群臣上謚曰文明武德大聖大宣孝皇帝，廟號肅宗。

translations.literal: The ministers gave the posthumous title Emperor of Civil Culture, Martial Virtue, Great Sagely, Great Manifest Filial Piety; his temple name was Suzong.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers named him Civil, Martial, Great Sagely, Great Manifest Filial; temple name Suzong.

sentences.zh: 寶應二年三月庚午，葬於建陵。

translations.literal: On gengwu in the third month of Baoying 2 he was buried at Jian Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in Baoying 2, third month, he was buried at Jian Tomb.

sentences.zh: 【論】史臣曰：臣每讀《詩》至許穆夫人聞宗國之顛覆，周大夫傷宮室之黍離，其辭情於邑，賦諭勤懇，未嘗不廢書興嘆。
